verdict.rationale: Bento is a tracing and observability platform for AI agents, so capturing multimodal payloads in traces is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence covers span capture over OpenTelemetry, SDK-level LLM call capture, bento.track_ai wrapping, and span tags. Nothing documents capturing images, audio, or file attachments inside traces, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture multimodal payloads (images, audio, files) inside my traces
